description: Post-AOR-consolidation structural ceiling for Insight Hub 2 after browser-CI, dead-code hardening, React 19 state-map compatibility, OSHA database-persistence hardening, discovery-first occupational work, isolated official-source webviews, and the native six-tool reviewer intelligence transplant. The active application keeps one shell, three global CSS layers, reviewed component-level style blocks, lazy-loaded workspaces, and protected Hub 2 intelligence ownership routes. The reviewer-derived Injuries & Medical Conditions, Job Intelligence, AOR Factors, Drug Checker, Clinical Calculators, and Standards Intelligence workspaces are rendered with the native Hub 2 Sidebar/HeaderBar/GlassCard design system rather than importing a second application shell. Injuries & Medical Conditions now restores the original Reviewer holographic injury-anatomy experience through a dedicated 24,000-point Three.js human-mesh projection, anterior/posterior controls, pointer-responsive depth, region hotspots, and O*NET-linked anatomical signals, while keeping Insight Hub 2 visual styling. AOR Factors is the single AOR workspace: command-scoped WHO/GDACS/USGS intelligence remains in the command view, while the former AOR Risk Intelligence resources (State travel advisories, country-detail WHO/GDACS, CrisisWatch, and source readiness) are wired into its Country Intelligence view. The standalone AOR Risk Intelligence page/navigation entry is removed, with its legacy URL retained only as a compatibility alias to AOR Factors. Standards Intelligence uses the full transplanted reviewer standards rule engine in its own native Hub 2 page. Duplicate files, generated artifacts, invalid coordinates, extra app shells, new unreachable frontend files, additional architecture candidates, and additional injected-style files remain prohibited unless this baseline is deliberately reviewed and updated.
